I think it's too rigid for my creative mind. I find it a bit stressful sometimes, especially when I have to calculate things for work or manage finances.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes. I get nervous when I see complex numbers. I worry I'll make a mistake. I'm not confident in my math skills. It's not my favorite subject. I'd rather talk about art or cooking than solve equations.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I haven't really used AI for math. I mostly rely on my own memory or ask friends. I'm skeptical about technology. I prefer real conversations. I think it might help, but I'm not sure about its reliability.

replies.According to you, how can LLMs be used t: LLMs can explain concepts simply. They can generate practice problems. They can give instant feedback. But they shouldn't replace teachers. They should support learning. Make math less scary for students. Help them understand, not just memorize.
